title: Craft ALL Eggs And Spawner
description: Allows you to craft ALL creature eggs in Minecraft, as well as the spawner.
body:
# **🥚 Craft ALL Eggs And Spawner**

Craft all creature spawn eggs in survival, as well as spawners, without creative mode.

This datapack adds crafting recipes for all Spawn Eggs and Spawners, allowing players to summon any creature directly in survival while respecting vanilla progression.

This is why some recipes may seem expensive: the goal is to prevent access too early in the game and to preserve gameplay balance.
Crafts are designed so that spawn eggs are mainly used inside spawners, and not spammed early game.

The datapack is designed to be progressive, balanced, and multiplayer-friendly, without breaking the gameplay experience.


## **_✨ Features_**

- ✅ All mobs available through crafting
- ✅ Craftable spawner with a deliberately high cost
- ✅ Balanced recipes
- ✅ Modular JSON structure, easy to modify or extend
- ✅ Compatible with singleplayer & multiplayer


## **_⚙️ Compatibility_**

- 🛠️ Compatible with Minecraft 1.21.7 – 26.2
- 📦 Vanilla datapack – no mods required


## _**🧩 Configuration**_

Simply add the datapack to your world’s datapacks folder, then reload the world.
